name: Sticky Sections Slide
description: Full-width scroll layout with a big hero title, stacked sticky half-width cards that alternate sides and slide up, images that rotate and scale in, and a closing statement.
contents: Sticky numbered cards each with image, title and text
Loading pulse shown until images load
behavior: Cards stick and slide up in sequence as the page scrolls
Images rise, rotate, scale and lose contrast with scroll scrub
Cards alternate left and right on large screens and fill the width on small screens
Smooth scroll is skipped when reduced motion is preferred

props.name: heroDescription
props.default: As data conglomerates reveled in the opulence of cognitive wealth, a silent underclass manifested, condemned to the digital periphery.

props.name: outro
props.default: Lost in perpetual dependency, inhabitants of the Synthetic Era found solace in cryptic simulations, where pain ebbed and cognitive loads momentarily lightened.

editableByProps: Hero text, outro, card images, titles, text and card colors
Background, text and loader colors, card radius, image size
Animation start and end values, scroll length, sticky offset, smoothing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change which cards use the earlier slide-out start
needsCodeEdit.where: start function with isLast and isPreLast inside the gsap.context block

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Full-screen loader overlay covers the page until images load
Cards are one viewport tall, with a 50vh spacer above the outro for scroll range
Loads DM Sans through @font-face rules built from fontFaces
